## RCarb 0.1.8 (2026-05-03)

- The function `write_InputTemplate()` gained a new argument `nrows` to
  control the number of rows returned in the template.
- Internal changes to better support the corresponding app in
  `RLumShiny`
- Remove logical argument `txtProgressBar`; this change will not break
  the function if used.
- Add new argument `multicore` for parallel processing of the Monte
  Carlo runs; with this change a new dependency to the package
  `parallel` was added. This package should be available by default in
  any modern installation of R.
